newsitem.title: USA: Stone & Youngberg urges defeat of Calif. measure.
newsitem.headline: Stone & Youngberg urges defeat of Calif. measure.

text.p: Stone & Youngberg LLC said Wednesday that Californians should reject a tax initiative that seeks to require voter approval for all new taxes, property-related fees and assessments.

"Because of the initiative's unnecessary, costly and potentially damaging changes to current law, as well as the uncertain effects the initiative would have on local government obligations, we have advised our clients to vote 'No' on (proposition) 218," said Tom Lockard, a principal at Stone & Youngberg, an underwriting firm.
"The initiative has been poorly crafted and its passage will burden government and increase bureaucracy," he added.
Stone & Youngberg, founded in 1931, is one of the oldest and largest firms specializing in California public finance.
Proposition 218, which will appear on the Nov 5 ballot, would limit the revenue raising ability of local governments, municipal analysts warn.
